# Chromepet Cultural Academy

> Music, dance, drama and discourses since 1969 — and our big-stage hall for your wedding, seating 400.

Website: https://ccatrust.org/
Phone / WhatsApp: +91 73388 33944

## Facilities
- Big stage with wide hall
- Seats 400
- AC rooms with attached bathrooms
- Dining hall
- Spacious kitchen
- CCTV cameras
- Dedicated support staff
- Separate car & two-wheeler parking
- Strictly vegetarian
- Academy sound & light

## Frequently asked questions

### How many guests can Chromepet Cultural Academy hold?
Our hall seats 400 guests, with a big stage and AC rooms on both sides.

### Where is Chromepet Cultural Academy?
#3, Indira Gandhi Cross Street, off Radha Nagar Main Road, Radha Nagar, Chromepet, Chennai 600 044 (0.75 km from Chromepet Railway Station).

### What facilities does Chromepet Cultural Academy have?
Big stage with wide hall, Seats 400, AC rooms with attached bathrooms, Dining hall, Spacious kitchen, CCTV cameras, Dedicated support staff, Separate car & two-wheeler parking, Strictly vegetarian, Academy sound & light.

### Is food at the hall vegetarian?
Yes. The hall is strictly vegetarian; no non-vegetarian food is allowed inside the mandapam.

### Can we bring our own decorator?
No. Sound and light arrangements are done only by the academy decorator.

### How do I book Chromepet Cultural Academy?
Pick a date in the booking section of this page and send it on WhatsApp, or call +91 73388 33944.
